subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold its launch-token behavior into the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam with one sandboxed browser trust model?
rationale: This is a durable Plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser security contract; automation can flag unsafe paths, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and isolation model before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed through one public seam.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint` only after removing top-level execution, using an opaque iframe sandbox, failing closed on launch errors, and refreshing proof.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR until the native-page issue and broader Control UI contribution RFC settle the public semantics.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed through one public seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the related generic host-hook foundation and the broader Control UI plugin contribution-slots RFC most directly tied to this API shape.
